reviews.review:
This feels rather like an unbaked horde shooter, ridden with stiff animations and unsatisfying gunplay, while it introduces modern shooter elements in the genre with ADS and the perk system, it all falls flat in comparison to Back 4 Blood's richer card loadout system and better gunplay; that in itself is an unfair comparison as this game is not really marketed as a AAA game, while the latter has the funding of Warner Bros. But that doesn't excuse that there are non-AAA games punching above their weight.

The main culprit of the unsatisfying gunplay is the limited amount of guns in the game you can choose from, and even then firing the said guns doesn't have any weight or feeling to it in what you expect from a futuristic gun, compared to the likes of the Borderlands franchise.

There are little to no objectives in the maps in the game, you just go from point A to point B, far from how other horde shooters are designed like B4B and L4D.

The only saving grace from this game are the aesthetic and setting of the game is one of the only positive thing that actually breathes some ounce of vibrancy of life into this otherwise lifeless gameplay. Another is the workshop mod support that follows the same tradition of L4D, so it may or may not inject this game with the adrenaline it needed to get it going, but then again if the player base is empty due to the shaky foundations of this game then it's like injecting adrenaline to a corpse at this point. And finally, it also follows the same tradition of L4D with having a campaign playthrough with PvP, so that alone is a win in my book compared to B4B.

Not the worst game I’ve played but it’s no Left 4 Dead. You can finish the current campaign in one sitting. It runs reasonably well on Steam Deck but you’ll notice drops when there’s a ‘horde’. 

I’d say if you can get this cheap then give it a go but there is not much of an online community so expect to play with AI which can be questionable at times or have the odd random drop in/out of your game.

Steam really needs to add a maybe.

This game is fun. I like the layout and once forced baby mode is off the hordes are fun. However, the issue is the game is Peer to Peer and the devs have heavily restricted the requirements to host a game. You may be able to host a single player solo game but not an online MP game. It is restricted by your internet and system specs. The devs refuse to explain how the system spec one works and I have to assume it means left over power? Which if so is pointless because as you get a stronger PC you up your system specs. If you have friends you can get around all of this and just play. Sometimes the game will hitch as the hosts PC lags from an influx of aliens.

I love the special aliens here, the theme, and design. The weapons do feel wimpy and I wish there were more. A lot of the skills you get from the matter compiler are in the category of "This is a Sophie's choice choosing between these 3" because they're all bad. The one that increases your total health doesn't heal you that amount. So you're stuck with a partially filled HP bar unless you waste one of your med kits. This also makes the skill WORTHLESS in horde more. Especially since the bots will spam them like L4D bots did when the game first launched.

I wish I could comment on the VS mode but every time I join one the hosts quit after I kill them once. You can't choose which side you want to be on in VS. This means if you and a friend join a VS match they can end up on humans and you will end up on aliens. This happened to me while I was playing with a friend.

I know this sounds negative but the game is insanely fun. The modding tools are really nice and the main thing is the devs need to chill on their requirements for P2P connections. This is making it impossible to find matches, assuming the devs are telling the truth on player numbers. A laggy match with players is better than no matches.

If you do not mind playing solo then sure, buy it. If you have friends then buy it as a group (they need a 4 pack deal) and the game will be a blast. The weeklies are great and horde mode is really challenging, at least with bots. Playing VS mode against bots is okay, they just bee line it to the end, and I imagine playing against people for longer than 5 minutes would be fun.  This game has a lot of conditionals towards me recommending it.
